items.text: Darby Hills represents the 26th District in the Illinois Senate, having been appointed in February 2025. She is a former Cook County prosecutor focused on child welfare and a former Barrington Hills trustee. She also founded Barrington Children's Charity.

sentences.text: Darby Hills represents the 26th District in the Illinois Senate, having been appointed in February 2025.
She is a former Cook County prosecutor focused on child welfare and a former Barrington Hills trustee.
She also founded Barrington Children's Charity.

items.text: In the Senate, she proposed a bill to add people who record or livestream minors for sexual purposes to the sex offender registry. She sponsored legislation requiring data centers to get written consent before building within three miles of another municipality. She serves as the minority spokesperson for the Child Welfare Committee. Her campaign says she supports lowering property taxes. Her campaign website also states she wants to cut taxes on diapers and prescription drugs.
